vectors: Bool board plus thirteen Bool masks; I64 class counts/classes/maxima. Existing native WasmGC arrays.
omitted_fill: Pinned Chez numeric zero is truthy; explicit Bool true preserves all board/mask truth tests. Canonical reset overwrites every cell.
initial_partial_projection: Truthiness only; numeric zero and true are not identical raw Scheme datums.
extra_setup_object: One shared empty Bool-row sentinel fills the outer vector, replaced before timing.
setup: Global scalar/vector allocations precede the harness definition; original list/traversal and thirteen fresh rows follow it before timing.
refs: Two globals plus assigned orientation index and initial next-hole local; trial placement result is immutable because its initializer was never read.
result: One shared failure variant; successful start snapshots the counter in a count constructor.
escape: Only local trial continuation becomes ordered Boolean control. No general continuation API is implemented.
input_domain: Decimal I64 count/size, Boolean-or-I64 expected datum; exact JSON transport outside safe Number range.
hiding: Use actual returned I64 size once per positive iteration, with original generic Chez hide in both canonical controls.
diagnostic_output: Initial placement error retains newline, Error., then trial(0); no early trap replacement.
failure_text_difference: Native wrapper reports acceptance 0; Chez prints the original actual result.
